text: The black box character of deep learning models is a governance failure and not merely a technical inconvenience: opacity obstructs debugging, obscures bias detection and mitigation, and prevents comprehension of how inputs become outputs.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
abstract: This opacity can obstruct the debugging process, obscure bias detection and mitigation, and hinder comprehension of AI decision-making.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: most pronounced in deep learning models
matters where decisions must be explained or audited
